map.等度保留时间 tR = t₀ × (1 + k')；梯度保留时间 = t₀ ×: Isocratic retention time tR = t₀ × (1 + k'); gradient retention time = t₀ × (1 + k') ÷ (1 + gradient slope × t₀ × k' ÷ 2) (used when the gradient slope > 0, otherwise the isocratic value is taken). Column volume (mL) = π × (inner diameter ÷ 2)² × column length ÷ 1000; estimated dwell volume = column volume × 0.3, dwell time = dwell volume ÷ flow rate. Optimization criteria: k' < 1 means retention is too weak, k' > 10 means retention is too strong and the analysis takes too long, and 1 ≤ k' ≤ 10 is suitable
